fighter.name: Block
fighter.description: Absorb damage using Defense + Might and counterattack.

wizard.name: Magic Shield
wizard.description: Reduce damage by 40% and reflect 15% for 2 enemy actions.

rogue.name: Dodge
rogue.description: Evade the next hit; your next basic attack deals 50% more damage.

arcaneBolt.name: Arcane Bolt
arcaneBolt.description: Arcane damage from level + Intellect; ignores Defense.

shieldBash.name: Shield Bash
shieldBash.description: 80% weapon damage and stun for 1 enemy action. No shield required.

heavyStrike.name: Heavy Strike
heavyStrike.description: 160% weapon damage; ignores 50% of total Defense.

poisonedBlade.name: Poisoned Blade
poisonedBlade.description: 70% weapon damage; poison for 3 enemy actions (2 + 20% Agility per tick).

backstab.name: Backstab
backstab.description: 140% weapon damage; ignores all Defense if no armor buff is active. Buffed targets retain full Defense.

manaSurge.name: Mana Surge
manaSurge.description: Spend half current Mana (rounded up, minimum 1); heal 4 + 80% Intellect and reduce other active cooldowns by 1 turn.

manaBurn.name: Mana Burn
manaBurn.description: 3 + 90% Intellect arcane damage, then burn 1% enemy Max HP for 3 enemy actions. Ignores Defense.
